title: Add Implementation-Agnostic Component Protocol with Plugin Support
body:
Implements a generic, implementation-agnostic UI component schema that defines "how to describe a UI tree" rather than "what properties each component has". This allows UI implementations to evolve independently while maintaining structural compatibility.

## Design Philosophy

**Protocol Layer Responsibility**: Define the tree structure (id, type, props, children, events, style, meta)  
**Implementation Layer Responsibility**: Define what each component type means and how to render it

This separation of concerns ensures the protocol remains stable while UI implementations can innovate freely.

## Schema Structure

**Generic Component Node** with flexible, extensible properties:

```typescript
export const ComponentSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string().optional(),                 // Unique component instance identifier
  type: z.string(),                          // Extensible component type identifier
  props: z.record(z.unknown()).optional(),   // Implementation-defined properties
  children: z.lazy(() => z.array(ComponentSchema)).optional(),  // Recursive nesting
  events: z.record(z.function()).optional(), // Event handler bindings
  style: z.record(z.string()).optional(),    // Custom CSS styles
  meta: z.record(z.unknown()).optional(),    // Editor/designer metadata
});
```

## Key Features

**1. Extensible Component Types**
- `type` is a flexible string, allowing custom component types without protocol changes
- No rigid enum constraining component innovation

**2. Generic Props Container**
- `props` accepts any key-value pairs via `z.record(z.unknown())`
- Protocol carries data without validating business logic
- UI implementations define their own prop requirements

**3. Recursive Composition**
- `children` supports unlimited nesting depth via `z.lazy()`
- Enables complex component trees for enterprise UIs

**4. Standard Event & Style Support**
- `events` for event handler bindings
- `style` for custom CSS styling
- These remain protocol-standard across all components

**5. Component Instance Identification**
- `id` field provides unique identifiers for component instances
- Essential for rendering engines, diff algorithms, and drag-drop editors
- First-class field for direct engine-layer management

**6. Editor & Plugin Metadata**
- `meta` field stores editor/designer-specific information
- Separates rendering props from non-rendering metadata
- Supports position data, locked states, binding paths, and plugin-specific data
- Prevents pollution of component props with editor-only information

## Usage Examples

**Simple Component**:
```typescript
const button: Component = {
  type: 'button',
  props: {
    label: 'Click me',
    variant: 'primary',
    customProp: 'any value'
  }
}
```

**Component with ID and Metadata** (for visual editors):
```typescript
const editableCard: Component = {
  id: 'user-profile-card',
  type: 'card',
  props: {
    title: 'User Profile',
    subtitle: 'Account Details'
  },
  meta: {
    x: 100,
    y: 200,
    locked: false,
    bindingPath: 'user.profile'
  }
}
```

**Nested Component Tree**:
```typescript
const form: Component = {
  type: 'form',
  props: { action: '/submit' },
  children: [
    {
      type: 'input',
      props: { name: 'username', placeholder: 'Enter username' }
    },
    {
      type: 'button',
      props: { type: 'submit', label: 'Login' }
    }
  ]
}
```

**Custom Components** (no protocol changes needed):
```typescript
const customWidget: Component = {
  type: 'my-custom-widget',
  props: {
    config: { foo: 'bar' },
    data: [1, 2, 3]
  }
}
```

## Files Changed

- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` - Generic component schema (~95 lines, reduced from ~970 lines)
- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.test.ts` - Structural validation tests
- `packages/spec/src/ui/index.ts` - Export configuration
- Auto-generated: JSON schema and MDX reference docs

## Testing

24 structural tests validate:
- Component type extensibility (any string accepted)
- Arbitrary prop passing (any key-value pairs)
- Recursive nesting (3+ levels deep)
- Event binding patterns
- Style property handling
- Real-world component trees (forms, tables, menus, modals)
- Component instance identification with `id` field
- Editor metadata with `meta` field
- Complex nested metadata structures

All tests passing ✅

## Benefits

✅ **Decoupled**: Protocol and implementation evolve independently  
✅ **Extensible**: New component types without protocol changes  
✅ **Maintainable**: Simple, focused protocol definition  
✅ **Future-proof**: Adaptable to any UI framework or library  
✅ **Editor-Ready**: Built-in support for visual editors and plugin systems  
✅ **Engine-Friendly**: First-class `id` field for efficient component tracking

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> 任务 4.2: 组件库协议
> 
> 文件: packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts
> 负责人: UI 协议负责人
> 工作量: 3 天

> 
> 实现要点:
> 
> // 可复用 UI 组件定义
> export const ComponentType = z.enum([
>   'card',
>   'tabs',
>   'accordion',
>   'modal',
>   'drawer',
>   'timeline',
>   'stepper',
>   'breadcrumb',
>   'alert',
>   'badge',
>   'tooltip',
>   'popover',
> ]);
> 
> export const ComponentSchema = z.object({
>   type: ComponentType,
>   props: z.record(z.any()).optional(),
>   children: z.lazy(() => z.array(ComponentSchema)).optional(),
>   events: z.record(z.function()).optional(),
>   style: z.record(z.string()).optional(),
> });
> 
> // 卡片组件
> export const CardComponentSchema = ComponentSchema.extend({
>   type: z.literal('card'),
>   props: z.object({
>     title: z.string().optional(),
>     subtitle: z.string().optional(),
>     image: z.string().url().optional(),
>     actions: z.array(z.any()).optional(),
>   }).optional(),
> });
> 
> // 标签页组件
> export const TabsComponentSchema = ComponentSchema.extend({
>   type: z.literal('tabs'),
>   props: z.object({
>     tabs: z.array(z.object({
>       label: z.string(),
>       icon: z.string().optional(),
>       content: ComponentSchema.optional(),
>     })),
>     defaultTab: z.number().int().min(0).optional(),
>   }),
> });
> 验收标准:
> 
>  定义所有常用组件
>  支持组件嵌套 (children)
>  支持事件绑定
>  文档包含渲染示例
